messages.subject: RE: customizing geom_point()
parts:
Hi Martin,

Is it something you would like to do….?

 

p <- ggplot(Data,aes(x=Quarter,y=value,colour=variable, shape=variable,size=variable))

p <- p +

    scale_shape_manual(values=c(16,2,3,4)) +

    scale_size_manual(values=c(5,3,3,3)) +

    geom_point() +ylab("Change (in %)") +

    opts(legend.key = theme_blank(), legend.title=theme_blank(), legend.position="top",legend.text=theme_text(size=15))

p

--Kaori

 

From: ggp...@googlegroups.com [mailto:ggp...@googlegroups.com] On Behalf Of mfe...@gmail.com
Sent: Wednesday, March 06, 2013 8:49 AM
To: ggp...@googlegroups.com
Subject: customizing geom_point()

 

Hi,

 

I would like to customize the following plot (using R.25.2, and ggplot2 version 0.9.3, reshape2 version 1.2.2):

 

Quarter=0:40; rData=matrix(rnorm(41*7),41,4);colnames(rData)=paste("Variable",1:4)

Data<-melt(data.frame(cbind(Quarter,rData)),id="Quarter")

  

p<-ggplot(Data,aes(x=Quarter,y=value,colour=variable,group=variable,shape=variable))
p<-p+scale_shape_manual(values=1:ncol(rData)) +geom_point(size=3) +ylab("Change (in %)")+opts(legend.key = theme_blank()) + opts(legend.title=theme_blank())+opts(legend.position="top")+
opts(legend.text=theme_text(size=15))  #+ylim(-2,4)
p

 

 

I would like to use a different size for the first column (i.e., variable) in rData (Variable 1) and also fill the shapes only for the first variable. I have tried with geom_point(size=c(4,3,3,3)) but it did not work out, also trying with different layers did not help. I do not want to have a continous scaling of the shapes in the plot (as is illustrated in the R package vignette to ggplot2), I just want to keep all shapes at a constant size (e.g, 3) and make the first one bigger than the others.

 

Any ideas, your help would be greatly appreciated.

 

Martin
